body:
I work on an open source project that uses celery and is encountering this bug also, though we're not using redis as a result backend.  One thing we've discovered is that you can cause celery to break out of this hung state and attempt to re-establish its connection by sending it `SIGHUP`.

```
celery==3.1.25
kombu==3.0.37
amqp==1.4.9
```
could you both try celery 4.2rc4 and see if it still persist?
are you facing this with celery 4.2?
I upgrade to celery 4.2.0,still have the same issue

old celery verison is 3.1.23, I try  to upgrade celery 3.x to 4.x.

FYI. In my case, I used chain to run task2 after task1 finished. When the return value of task1 is too large (~100M) and large number of tasks are executing at the same time, the problem occurs. Set and get return value to redis by myself resolved the problem.
@rabbit8ge could you come up with a pr with an appropriate fix?
